card.name: Setting up a comparison of two cases
card.fires_on: Small linking words right after a pair or contrast is set up, such as two ponds, two pots or one cycle versus the other. It marks the spot where the next item (one... the other) is expected.

modes.label: Two-group experiment setup
modes.description: Verb or preposition right after 'two' items in a described experiment or test.
modes.example: Two duck ponds<< were>> chosen, several miles apart.

modes.label: One versus the other
modes.description: Word at the point where one of two things is being contrasted with the other.
modes.example: during one cycle and placebo<< during>> the other.

modes.label: Classroom or activity instructions
modes.description: Linking word in teaching instructions to do the same thing again, individually or as a class.
modes.example: get students to do this same<< for>> themselves individually.
